Description: Canal Park is a tourist and recreation-oriented district of Duluth, Minnesota, United States. Situated across the Interstate 35 freeway from Downtown Duluth, it is connected by the famous Aerial Lift Bridge to the Park Point sandbar and neighborhood.

The Aerial Lift Bridge is a landmark in the port city of Duluth, Minnesota. The span began life in 1905 as the United States' first transporter bridge. In 1929–30, the span was converted to a vertical lift bridge, and continues to operate today.
Glensheen, the Historic Congdon Estate is a 20,000 square foot mansion in Duluth, Minnesota, United States, operated by the University of Minnesota Duluth as a historic house museum.

The Great Lakes Aquarium opened in 2000 and is located on the Duluth waterfront. A 501 private nonprofit, its mission is to inspire people to explore their connection to Lake Superior and waters of the world.

Jay Cooke State Park is a state park of Minnesota, United States, protecting the lower reaches of the St. Louis River. The park is located about 10 miles southwest of Duluth and is one of the ten most visited state parks in Minnesota. The western half of the park contains part of a rocky, 13-mile gorge.
Duluth Farmer Market is a locally centered market offering a wide variety of fruits, veggies, flowers, meats, honey, dairy, and preserves. Open seasonally, Wednesdays and Saturdays.

Leif Erikson Park is a green space along the shore of Lake Superior. It is known for its expansive Rose Garden featuring a marble gazebo, a fountain, and over 3000 blooming rose bushes. It's a scenic and relaxing spot for a nice break from the city

The Lake Superior Zoo is open year-round and is a family-friendly atmosphere. The zoo features over 300 animals and 140 species. Features both indoor and outdoor exhibits and focuses on animal welfare and conservation.

Hartley Nature Center offers a large area for hiking, cycling, cross-country skiing, and fishing. There is also a nature center with exhibits. They are a nonprofit organization dedicated to environmental education for all. They provide programs, equipment rental, park and trail work, and general park information.

Fitger's is a historic, repurposed brewery complex on Lake Superior. The complex stretched 700 feet along the Lake Superior shore. It is a rustic-chic hub featuring a renowned brewpub, a boutique hotel, shops, and a spa. It is a central gathering place hosting events like live music and festivals.
